held.headline: Moldova approves 60-day energy and water state of emergency
held.reason: Fresh consequential public-service story independently corroborated by Reuters and AP. Editorial sourcing gate passed, but this cycle did not establish a relevant legally reusable documentary/context image with complete source, creator, licence/reuse basis, dimensions, caption and alt text. Held rather than publishing without the required image-rights package.

held.headline: Xi Jinping begins September 23-25 US visit ahead of Trump meeting
held.reason: The visit dates are confirmed by Reuters and AP reporting around the Trump-Xi meeting, but this cycle did not complete an event-specific reusable image package with all required rights metadata. Held rather than publishing an incompletely cleared visual record.

held.headline: Typhoon Dujuan leaves four dead in Japan and tens of thousands without power
held.reason: Fresh consequential disaster update was found in an approved newsroom, but independent second-newsroom corroboration for the material casualty/power claims was not completed in this cycle and no fully rights-cleared event image package was established.

held.headline: Russia's jet-powered drones increasingly strain Ukraine air defences
held.reason: Consequential active-conflict reporting, but the high-impact gate requires independent corroboration where reasonably possible; this cycle did not complete a second approved-newsroom source for the material new claims or a fully rights-cleared relevant image package.

audit.note: No story is claimed live unless sourcing, editorial verification, image rights, canonical article/edition records, deployment and public-route verification all pass. This cycle found strong fresh candidates but did not clear the mandatory image-rights package for any candidate; high-impact single-source candidates were also held. No documentary image was fabricated.
audit.blocker: No candidate cleared the complete image-rights gate; therefore no publishable Worldwide payload was produced and deployment was intentionally not triggered.
